score_problems.why: As written the profiler follows the Austin Mills precedent (second facility, no address, distance unknown -> 0). What this check found bears on the call: every General Steel source gives one address. Fisher's locations page lists GENERAL STEEL & SUPPLY COMPANY only at 3020 Energy Drive (shared with Fisher Industries HQ and Fisher Sand & Gravel Company); the April 20, 2021 Dickinson Press ad gives 3020 Energy Drive as the only address for "a 40,000 sq ft repair facility, a 56,000 sq ft manufacturing facility, and a 100,000 sq ft warehouse" and says "Our Dickinson location" (singular); ECHO has General Steel only at 3020 Energy Dr, with Fisher Building 4 (3076 Energy Dr) about 20 m away. No source places a General Steel facility anywhere else, in Dickinson or out of it. Unlike Austin Mills (a stated separate leased facility) and Brookville (a known second address 1.3 km away), here the second facility is most likely the repair building on the same address. Two further points: (a) if the second facility is outside Dickinson, the city-only postings count under the written rule anyway (no other production site in Dickinson); (b) under the ships repair-only precedent a repair building is not a production site. Against: the ad is from 2021 and names no building addresses; ECHO also carries a street-less "FISHER MARTIN INC SHOP NORTHGATE INDUSTRIAL PARK" record in Dickinson (110056191614) whose operator and use are unknown. Upside components re-derived and correct: process 12 (GTAW beside GMAW in the production Fabrication Welder posting, mining rule 2; Welder I "stick and wire" earns nothing under ruling 6); material 20 (stainless stated; 13 ft separator "fabricated by General Steel" and 36 in x 10 ft pugmill fit the 2026 analyst cell); labor 20 (two at once, Welder I open 152 days, $1,000 sign-on on both); scale falls to 0 under TAG if the two facilities are one campus.
